blocks.text: British-Norwegian pop group a1 are celebrating their special relationship with the Philippines with the release of their brand-new single, “In Love in the Philippines,” available exclusively in the Philippines from September 25. Written and produced by a1, the uplifting new track is inspired by falling in love with both a person and a place — and by a country that has held a special place in the band’s story for more than two decades. The Philippines has remained one of a1’s most passionate homes away from home, with Filipino fans continuing to support the band across generations. “We’ve shared so many […]...
